description: 30 tok/s for 20B MoE on 8 GB VRAM. Flat throughput to 32K context. Native MXFP4 + GGUF Q4_K/Q5_K/Q6_K via ggml CUDA kernels — zero dequant. Expert offloading for models that don't fit in GPU memory.
